LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleTraditional: 地方 + 有／沒有 + 東西
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.titleEnglish: Say What Is in a Place
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.learnerPromise: Say what is in a place—and what is not there.
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FIVE.explanation: Say the place first, then 有, then the thing that is there. Use 沒有—not 不有—to say something is not there.

teachingGlossary.meaning: there is not; there are not
none of them have; nowhere has
ending word for a yes/no question

teachingGlossary.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

discoveryLab.title: Explore this pattern
discoveryLab.description: Say the place first, then 有, then the thing that is there. Use 沒有—not 不有—to say something is not there.

choices.label: Book sentence 1
choices.traditional: 台灣有很多好吃的東西。
choices.simplified: 台湾有很多好吃的东西。
choices.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de dōngxi.
choices.english: There is a lot of delicious food in Taiwan.
choices.note: The place comes before 有 or 沒有.

choices.label: Book sentence 2
choices.traditional: 圖書館旁邊沒有咖啡廳。
choices.simplified: 图书馆旁边没有咖啡厅。
choices.english: There is no café next to the library.
choices.note: The place comes before 有 or 沒有.

choices.label: Book sentence 3
choices.pinyin: Zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu hěn duō dōngxi.
choices.english: There are a lot of things on the table.
choices.note: The place comes before 有 or 沒有.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Say the place first, then 有, then the thing that is there. Use 沒有—not 不有—to say something is not there.

patternRows.english: There is a lot of delicious food in Taiwan.

grammar.meaning: there is not; there are not

patternRows.english: There is no café next to the library.
There are a lot of things on the table.

items.question: What comes first when I say what is on the table?
items.answer: Start with the place, then 有, then the things.

right.pinyin: zhuōzi shàngmiàn yǒu hěn duō dōngxi.
right.english: There are a lot of things on the table.

items.question: Do I negate 有 with 不 or 沒?
items.answer: Use 沒 before 有: 沒有.
items.wrongTraditional: 圖書館旁邊不有咖啡廳。
items.wrongSimplified: 图书馆旁边不有咖啡厅。

right.traditional: 圖書館旁邊沒有咖啡廳。
right.simplified: 图书馆旁边没有咖啡厅。
right.english: There is no café next to the library.

words.meaning: there is not; there are not

text.traditional: A：台灣有什麼好吃的東西？ B：水果、牛肉麵跟小籠包，我都很喜歡。
text.simplified: A：台湾有什么好吃的东西？ B：水果、牛肉面跟小笼包，我都很喜欢。
text.pinyin: A: Táiwān yǒu shénme hǎochī de dōngxi? B: Shuǐguǒ, niúròu miàn gēn xiǎolóngbāo, wǒ dōu hěn xǐhuān.
text.english: A: What delicious foods are in Taiwan? B: I like fruit, beef noodles, and soup dumplings.

text.traditional: A：你們學校旁邊有什麼？ B：我們學校旁邊有一家很大的餐廳。
text.simplified: A：你们学校旁边有什么？ B：我们学校旁边有一家很大的餐厅。
text.pinyin: A: Nǐmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu shénme? B: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng.
text.english: A: What is beside your school? B: There is a large restaurant beside our school.

words.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

text.traditional: A：那個房間裡面有桌子、椅子嗎？ B：房間裡面有一張桌子跟兩張椅子。
text.simplified: A：那个房间里面有桌子、椅子吗？ B：房间里面有一张桌子跟两张椅子。
text.pinyin: A: Nà ge fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu zhuōzi, yǐzi ma? B: Fángjiān lǐmiàn yǒu yì zhāng zhuōzi gēn liǎng zhāng yǐzi.
text.english: A: Are there tables and chairs in that room? B: There is one table and two chairs.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FOUR.learnerPromise: Locate something precisely: inside, on, under, beside, in front, or behind.
LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FOUR.explanation: Put a direction word after a noun to give the direction and location of a place, as in 桌子上面 or 學校旁邊.

teachingGlossary.meaning: there is not; there are not
none of them have; nowhere has
ending word for a yes/no question

teachingGlossary.pinyin: yì jiā hěn dà de cāntīng

LESSON_FIVE_GRAMMAR_FOUR.pattern: Subject +（不）在 + place word; Subject + 在 + place word + verb

discoveryLab.title: Explore this pattern
discoveryLab.description: Put a direction word after a noun to describe a location, as in 桌子上面 or 學校旁邊.

choices.label: Book sentence 1
choices.pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài zhuōzi shàngmiàn.
choices.english: Your book is on the table.
choices.note: Compare the word order with the pattern table.

choices.label: Book sentence 2
choices.traditional: 那家餐廳不在學校旁邊。
choices.simplified: 那家餐厅不在学校旁边。
choices.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng bú zài xuéxiào pángbiān.
choices.english: That restaurant is not next to the school.
choices.note: Compare the word order with the pattern table.

discoveryLab.takeaway: Put a direction word after a noun to describe a location, as in 桌子上面 or 學校旁邊.

items.question: Do I say 在下面椅子 or 在椅子下面?
items.answer: Anchor word first, direction second: 椅子下面.

right.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài yǐzi xiàmiàn.
right.english: Your pen is under the chair.

items.question: My older brother is inside the room. Is it 在房間上面?
items.answer: No. 上面 means on top. For inside a room, use 裡面.

right.english: My older brother is inside the room.

text.traditional: A：那家餐廳在你家旁邊嗎？ B：不在我家旁邊，在我家後面。
text.simplified: A：那家餐厅在你家旁边吗？ B：不在我家旁边，在我家后面。
text.pinyin: A: Nà jiā cāntīng zài nǐ jiā pángbiān ma? B: Bú zài wǒ jiā pángbiān, zài wǒ jiā hòumiàn.
text.english: A: Is that restaurant next to your home? B: No, it is behind my home.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: A：我的筆在哪裡？ B：你看，你的筆在椅子下面。
text.simplified: A：我的笔在哪里？ B：你看，你的笔在椅子下面。
text.pinyin: A: Wǒ de bǐ zài nǎlǐ? B: Nǐ kàn, nǐ de bǐ zài yǐzi xiàmiàn.
text.english: A: Where is my pen? B: Look. Your pen is under the chair.

text.traditional: A：他們都在房間裡面嗎？ B：哥哥在房間裡面，我不知道弟弟在哪裡。
text.simplified: A：他们都在房间里面吗？ B：哥哥在房间里面，我不知道弟弟在哪里。
text.pinyin: A: Tāmen dōu zài fángjiān lǐmiàn ma? B: Gēge zài fángjiān lǐmiàn, wǒ bù zhīdào dìdi zài nǎlǐ.
text.english: A: Are they all inside the room? B: My older brother is inside the room. I do not know where my younger brother is.

words.meaning: ending word for a yes/no question

text.traditional: 他在房間裡睡覺。
text.simplified: 他在房间里睡觉。
text.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān lǐ shuìjiào.
text.english: He is sleeping in his room.

text.traditional: 那個孩子在媽媽旁邊看書。
text.simplified: 那个孩子在妈妈旁边看书。
text.pinyin: Nà ge háizi zài māma pángbiān kànshū.
text.english: That child is reading next to his mother.

text.traditional: 他們在圖書館外面做什麼？
text.simplified: 他们在图书馆外面做什么？
text.pinyin: Tāmen zài túshūguǎn wàimiàn zuò shénme?
text.english: What are they doing outside the library?

dialogue.title: 對話二 · Dialogue 2
dialogue.setting: 找不見的錢包 · Searching for a missing wallet

text.traditional: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
text.simplified: 妈，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的钱包不在房间里。
text.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
text.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going for afternoon tea, but my wallet is not in my room.

text.traditional: 客廳的桌子上有一個錢包，是不是你的？
text.simplified: 客厅的桌子上有一个钱包，是不是你的？
text.pinyin: Kètīng de zhuōzi shàng yǒu yí ge qiánbāo, shì bú shì nǐ de?
text.english: There is a wallet on the living-room table. Is it yours?

text.traditional: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
text.simplified: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的钱包不在客厅里。
text.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
text.english: That is not mine; it is my older brother’s. My wallet is not in the living room.

text.traditional: 沙發下面呢？
text.simplified: 沙发下面呢？
text.pinyin: Shāfā xiàmiàn ne?
text.english: What about under the sofa?

text.traditional: 沙發上面、下面跟旁邊都沒有。媽，妳幫我找，好嗎？
text.simplified: 沙发上面、下面跟旁边都没有。妈，你帮我找，好吗？
text.pinyin: Shāfā shàngmiàn, xiàmiàn gēn pángbiān dōu méiyǒu. Mā, nǐ bāng wǒ zhǎo, hǎo ma?
text.english: It is not on, under, or beside the sofa. Mom, can you help me look?

words.meaning: none of them have; nowhere has

text.traditional: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
text.simplified: 我很忙，现在要去厨房做饭，你再去房间找吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
text.english: I am busy and need to cook. Go search your room again.

text.traditional: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
text.simplified: 啊！在这里！钱包在我的书下面。
text.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
text.english: Ah, here it is! The wallet is under my book.
